name: 78ceb9-google-session
goal: Prove a stock Chrome website session survives container recreation, detect ended Google sessions without DevTools and notify Chief of Staff only on confirmed expiry.

evidence: Review of #445: the guest uses a real Chrome profile but never checks Google state and the E2E only persists a fixture file. Desired behavior: check a normal Google Account page from the existing browser, return a closed status only, and retain the website session on encrypted executor storage.

Strengthen the protected Chrome source assertion and existing no-network Docker smoke. Check a synthetic HTTP session before sign-in, after the website sets a cookie, after Chrome and the container restart, and after expiry. Unknown or failed navigation is distinct from expiry.
